capabilities: Render charts from a Bases view by counting notes and summing property values by category or date
Create charts from chart code blocks with inline data
Render computed data via one-call script functions
Pass full Chart.js 4 configs with time axes, sankey diagrams and annotations
Copy a chart as a PNG image to the clipboard
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README documents privacy: read-only vault access, clipboard only on request, no outbound network requests.
intentEvidence: Notes written for Charts work without changes and draw on Chart.js 4, so you no longer need Charts.
motivation: To make charts from Bases views, code blocks or scripts with less code than other chart plugins need and no second plugin beside them.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in charting, and existing chart plugins require long scripts or a second plugin to produce common charts.
